overlaps.text: Overlapping highlights get darker where they overlap.

unicode.text: 문장 분석 🧪 은 겹친 👩‍💻 하이라이트를 봅니다.

wrap.text: One analysis may cover a sentence that wraps across several lines, and another may cover only a few words inside it, so both must stay on their characters at any width.

whitespace.text:
Two  spaces
and a newline   stay counted.

distinct.text: One analysis may cover a sentence that another analysis covers again, and a third covers a few words.

similar.text: One analysis may cover a sentence that another analysis covers again, and a third covers a few words.
